projects.title: Capstone Static Checks for Programming Exercises
bullets: Implemented abstract syntax tree traversal in Python for static checks on small programming exercises as part of a supervised undergraduate capstone team.
Documented false-positive cases for the capstone's static checks, focusing on public numeric-computation example programs.

research.title: Public Transportation Graph Search
bullets: Constructed graphs from public urban bus route tables using Python and NetworkX as a student assistant in supervised faculty research.
Tested disconnected graph cases and compared path-search times on sampled graphs for the public transportation graph study.
